quotations.old_english: We sceolan andettan ða sóðan geleáffulnesse on úrne Drihten
quotations.english: we must confess the true belief in our Lord

source_text: ge-leáffulnes, -ness, -nys, -nyss, e; f. Faithfulness, belief, trust; f&i-short;d&e-long;l&i-short;tas, cr&e-long;d&u-short;l&i-short;tas :-- Geleáffulnys cr&e-long;d&u-short;l&i-short;tas, Ælfc. Gr. 9, 25; Som. 10, 64. We sceolan andettan ða sóðan geleáffulnesse on úrne Drihten we must confess the true belief in our Lord, Blickl. Homl. 111, 6.
